## Status

- [ ] Implemented
- [ ] In progress
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Infrastructure or tooling

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm validate:workspace`
- [ ] CLI smoke test, when the CLI changed

## Review notes

- [ ] Framework and CLI boundaries are respected.
- [ ] There is one source of truth for each rule or profile.
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` values, tokens, or private addresses were added.
- [ ] Claims match what the code and tests actually provide.
